nodes.label: vector database
nodes.def: A specialized database system optimized for storing, indexing, and searching high-dimensional vector embeddings by similarity.

nodes.label: approximate nearest neighbor
nodes.def: An ANN algorithm that trades exact recall for sub-linear query time by probabilistically organizing the embedding space into clusters or graphs.

nodes.label: chroma collection
nodes.def: A named namespace within Chroma that stores embeddings, associated documents, metadata, and IDs as an isolated group.

nodes.label: faiss
nodes.def: Meta's open-source C++/Python library for dense vector similarity search; implements IVF, PQ, HNSW, ONNG, and GPU-accelerated kernels with optional 8-bit quantization.

nodes.label: hnsw index
nodes.def: Hierarchical Navigable Small World graph; layered skip-list + NN graph enabling logarithmic-layer traversal then constant-time local search.

nodes.label: ivf index
nodes.def: Inverted File Index; clusters vectors into Voronoi cells via k-means; search prunes to nearest centroids then scans partitions.

nodes.label: nearest neighbor search
nodes.def: Query operation returning the k closest vectors by a distance or similarity metric in embedding space.

nodes.label: product quantization
nodes.def: A vector quantization technique that splits a high-dimensional vector into subvectors, independently quantizes each subvector, and concatenates codes to form a compact representati

nodes.label: sentence embedding
nodes.def: A dense vector that represents the semantic content of an individual sentence, produced by a sentence-transformer model and stored as a single record in the vector database.

nodes.label: chroma query
nodes.def: A search request containing a query vector (or text to embed) plus optional top-k and metadata filter parameters.

nodes.label: embedding model
nodes.def: A trained neural network that converts raw tokens or image patches into fixed-length dense vectors in the embedding space.

nodes.label: idx algorithm selection
nodes.def: Choice among ANN index types HNSW IVF ANNOY LSH determined by data scale query patterns and accuracy requirements

nodes.label: memory footprint
nodes.def: RAM or VRAM required to hold index and vectors; quantization (PQ, int8) is the primary compression lever.

nodes.label: pinecone query
nodes.def: A read operation that returns approximate nearest neighbors to a query vector with optional metadata filtering and namespace scoping.

nodes.label: pinecone record
nodes.def: A data unit in Pinecone containing id, dense vector values, optional sparse values, and key-value metadata.

nodes.label: semantic search
nodes.def: An information retrieval paradigm that finds results based on semantic meaning rather than exact keyword overlap, enabled by embedding-based similarity in a vector database.

nodes.label: vector embedding
nodes.def: Dense numerical representation of discrete data (text, image, audio) as a point in high-dimensional continuous space where geometric proximity encodes semantic similarity.

nodes.label: bm25 sparse retrieval
nodes.def: Lexical baseline using term frequency and document length normalization; complements dense retrieval for exact-match queries.

nodes.label: chroma embedding
nodes.def: A dense vector of floating-point numbers produced by an embedding function, representing the semantic position of a document in high-dimensional space.

nodes.label: embedding aggregation
nodes.def: A method for combining multiple embedding vectors (from document chunks, sentences, or modalities) into a single representative vector through averaging or weighted summation.

nodes.label: embedding pipeline
nodes.def: An end-to-end data processing workflow that ingests raw content, applies preprocessing, chunks text into segments, and produces embedding vectors for storage in the vector database

nodes.label: hybrid search
nodes.def: A retrieval strategy that combines dense vector similarity search with sparse keyword-based retrieval (BM25) to capture both semantic nuance and exact term matching.

nodes.label: idx hybrid composition
nodes.def: Strategy combining multiple index types such as HNSW over PQ or IVF with scalar quantization to balance speed accuracy and memory

nodes.label: idx memory budget
nodes.def: Available RAM or VRAM for index and raw vectors constraining quantization choices and index density

nodes.label: idx parameter sweep
nodes.def: Systematic exploration of parameter space to find optimal recall speed trade off for given constraints

nodes.label: pinecone
nodes.def: A managed cloud vector database service that provides serverless ANN indexing, real-time upserts, filtering, and multi-tenancy with SLA-backed availability.

nodes.label: scalar quantization
nodes.def: Floating-point values mapped to low-precision (e.g. int8); reduces memory 4x with modest accuracy loss.

nodes.label: anomaly detection embedding
nodes.def: Computing embedding for data point and measuring distance to cluster centroid; large distance flags anomalous behavior.

nodes.label: asymmetric quantization
nodes.def: A quantization scheme using both scale_factor and zero_point to map an arbitrary [min, max] float range to the integer domain, enabling better utilization of the quantization range

nodes.label: chroma client
nodes.def: The primary Python API client for Chroma; wraps HTTP or in-memory transport to a Chroma server or persistence layer.

nodes.label: chroma document
nodes.def: The raw text or payload string that is embedded and stored alongside its vector representation in a collection.

nodes.label: chroma filter
nodes.def: A metadata predicate applied at query time to restrict which entries are considered during approximate nearest-neighbor search.

nodes.label: collaborative filtering
nodes.def: A recommendation approach that learns joint user-item embedding vectors from interaction history, capturing latent taste factors without requiring explicit item content features.

nodes.label: content based filtering
nodes.def: A recommendation approach that encodes item attributes into embedding vectors and retrieves items with embeddings similar to a user profile embedding.

nodes.label: continual learning
nodes.def: A model adaptation paradigm that incrementally learns new concepts while preserving performance on previously learned ones, addressing the stability-plasticity dilemma in evolving

nodes.label: cosine similarity
nodes.def: A scalar similarity measure equal to the cosine of the angle between two vectors; range [-1, 1], with 1 indicating identical direction in the embedding space.

nodes.label: cross encoder
nodes.def: A neural model that takes a query-document pair as a concatenated input and outputs a relevance score; more accurate than bi-encoder but too slow for first-stage retrieval.

nodes.label: dense vector
nodes.def: A vector representation where most or all dimensions carry meaningful non-zero values, in contrast to sparse one-hot or bag-of-words encodings.

nodes.label: dimension reduction
nodes.def: Technique (PCA, UMAP, t-SNE) mapping high-dimensional embeddings to lower dimensions for visualization or efficiency.

nodes.label: document embedding
nodes.def: A single dense vector that summarizes the semantic content of an entire document, computed by pooling token-level embeddings or aggregating sentence-level vectors.

nodes.label: embedding cache
nodes.def: A key-value store (Redis, memcached, disk) that persists computed embedding vectors to avoid redundant model inference for identical or duplicate inputs.

nodes.label: embedding dimension
nodes.def: The length of the numerical vector produced by an embedding model; higher dimensions capture richer semantic nuance but increase storage, index size, and compute cost.

nodes.label: embedding drift
nodes.def: The gradual shift in embedding vector distributions over time as the underlying embedding model is retrained or the data semantics evolve, causing previously indexed vectors to bec

nodes.label: extends pinecone index
nodes.def: The inheritance relationship where pod-based and serverless deployment models specialize the base Pinecone index concept with distinct compute strategies.

nodes.label: idx query latency budget
nodes.def: Maximum acceptable query response time constraining algorithm selection and pruning aggressiveness

nodes.label: idx recall target
nodes.def: Desired fraction of true nearest neighbors returned governing aggressiveness of search pruning and parameter tuning

nodes.label: idx workload profiling
nodes.def: Analysis of query distribution vector density and access patterns informing algorithm and parameter selection

nodes.label: image embedding
nodes.def: A dense vector extracted from an image by a vision transformer, CNN backbone, or CLIP vision encoder.

nodes.label: incremental indexing
nodes.def: The ability to insert new vectors into an existing ANN index without rebuilding the entire structure from scratch; supported variably by different index types.

nodes.label: indexing strategy
nodes.def: Choice and configuration of ANN algorithm (HNSW, IVF, ANNOY, LSH) and its parameters (ef, nlist, nprobe) governing recall/speed trade-off.

nodes.label: is component of pinecone record
nodes.def: The partitive relationship where a dense or sparse vector constitutes one of the mandatory or optional fields of a Pinecone record.

nodes.label: metadata filtering
nodes.def: Pre-filtering step applying structured attribute conditions (date, category) before or after vector similarity search.

nodes.label: milvus
nodes.def: An open-source cloud-native vector database developed by Zilliz; supports multiple ANN indexes (HNSW, IVF, DiskANN), GPU acceleration, and distributed shard/replica deployments.

nodes.label: pinecone grpc api
nodes.def: A Pinecone transport layer using gRPC for low-latency upsert and query operations.

nodes.label: pinecone project
nodes.def: The top-level organizational unit in Pinecone that scopes API keys, indexes, and billing.

nodes.label: pinecone python client
nodes.def: An official Python SDK for Pinecone providing typed wrappers around REST and gRPC APIs.

nodes.label: qdrant
nodes.def: An open-source vector similarity search engine with a Rust core; provides HNSW and SCAN indexing, payload filtering, quantization, and a gRPC-first API.

nodes.label: query latency
nodes.def: The end-to-end time to submit a query vector and receive an ordered list of nearest neighbor IDs from a vector database.

nodes.label: reads from pinecone index
nodes.def: The data access relationship where fetch or query operations retrieve stored records from a Pinecone index by id or vector similarity.

nodes.label: recall at k
nodes.def: The fraction of all true nearest neighbors that appear within the top-k results returned by an approximate search; k must be larger than the number of true neighbors to approach 10

nodes.label: recommendation system
nodes.def: A system that suggests relevant items to users based on learned embeddings of users and items, using vector similarity search to retrieve candidate items from a collaborative or co

nodes.label: reranking
nodes.def: A two-stage retrieval process where an initial ANN search produces a candidate set that is then re-scored by a more expensive but accurate cross-encoder model.

nodes.label: semantic chunking
nodes.def: Splitting documents into segments sized for embedding (typically 256–1024 tokens) to maximize topical coherence per chunk.

nodes.label: shard partitioning
nodes.def: Distributing vector collection across multiple nodes; strategies include semantic clustering (by embedding region) or random partitioning.

nodes.label: similarity threshold
nodes.def: Minimum score below which results are discarded; tuned per use case to balance recall against noise.

nodes.label: sparse vector
nodes.def: A vector representation with mostly zero values, typical of BM25-weighted or TF-IDF bag-of-words encodings; often used alongside dense vectors in hybrid search.

nodes.label: writes to pinecone index
nodes.def: The data mutation relationship where upsert or delete operations modify the record set stored within a Pinecone index.

nodes.label: ann benchmark
nodes.def: A reproducible evaluation framework that measures recall, QPS, and build time for ANN implementations across fixed datasets (deep-image-96, sift-128) under standardized query budge

nodes.label: approximate query
nodes.def: A retrieval query that returns an approximate set of nearest neighbors rather than exact results, trading guaranteed recall for reduced query latency and lower computational cost.

nodes.label: authenticates to pinecone project
nodes.def: The relationship where a scoped API key grants authenticated access to a specific Pinecone project and its resources.

nodes.label: backup recovery
nodes.def: The process of periodically snapshotting a vector database's index files and payload state to durable object storage for restoration in the event of data loss or corruption.

nodes.label: batch embedding
nodes.def: The process of running multiple inputs through an embedding model simultaneously in a single forward pass to maximize GPU throughput and reduce per-item latency.

nodes.label: belongs to pinecone index
nodes.def: The containment relationship indicating a record resides within a specific Pinecone index for storage and retrieval.

nodes.label: belongs to pinecone namespace
nodes.def: The tenancy relationship indicating a record is scoped to a particular namespace within a Pinecone index.

nodes.label: bi encoder
nodes.def: An embedding model that independently encodes a query and a document into vectors, then computes similarity via a fast distance metric; enables pre-computed document vectors.

nodes.label: bm25
nodes.def: Okapi Best Matching 25: a probabilistic sparse retrieval model that scores documents by term frequency and inverse document frequency with length normalization.

nodes.label: catastrophic forgetting
nodes.def: The destructive overwriting of previously learned semantic relationships when an embedding model is fine-tuned on new data without regularization against the old embedding distribu

nodes.label: chroma
nodes.def: An open-source embedded vector database written in Python; designed for developer simplicity with in-memory or persistence mode, commonly used in LLM and RAG applications.

nodes.label: chroma distance metric
nodes.def: The similarity measure used for nearest-neighbor ranking; Chroma supports cosine, euclidean, and dot product distances.

nodes.label: chroma embedding function
nodes.def: A callable that converts raw input documents into embedding vectors; Chroma supports multiple backends (sentence-transformers, OpenAI, Cohere, etc.).

nodes.label: chroma entry id
nodes.def: A unique identifier string assigned to each embedded document within a collection; used for targeted get/delete operations.

nodes.label: chroma in memory mode
nodes.def: An ephemeral Chroma instantiation where all data lives in process memory with optional snapshot-to-disk; no server required.

nodes.label: chroma metadata
nodes.def: Structured key-value attributes attached to an embedding entry; enables filtering and payload queries at query time.

nodes.label: chroma persistence
nodes.def: The mechanism for checkpointing collection state to disk; Chroma writes SQLite and binary files to a configurable root directory.

nodes.label: chroma result set
nodes.def: The ordered list of matches returned by a query, containing entry IDs, documents, metadata, and distance scores.

nodes.label: chroma server
nodes.def: A long-running Chroma process that exposes a REST or gRPC API, managing one or more collections for remote clients.

nodes.label: chunking
nodes.def: The process of splitting a long document into smaller text segments (sentences, paragraphs, or fixed token windows) before embedding each chunk as a discrete vector.

nodes.label: clipping threshold
nodes.def: A boundary value defining where outliers are clipped during quantization; values beyond the threshold are mapped to the quantization range extrema, introducing bounded error.

nodes.label: clustering
nodes.def: An unsupervised partitioning of the embedding space into k groups such that vectors within a cluster share geometric or semantic proximity.

nodes.label: clustering quality
nodes.def: An evaluation metric for embedding space organization measured by silhouette score, Davies-Bouldin index, or cluster purity against a labeled ground-truth partition of the data.

nodes.label: colbert late interaction
nodes.def: Model producing per-token vectors; retrieval uses MaxSim operator (max over token similarities) enabling fine-grained phrase matching.

nodes.label: concept drift
nodes.def: A change in the statistical properties of the input data distribution that causes an embedding model trained on historical data to produce suboptimal representations for new inputs

nodes.label: configures pinecone index
nodes.def: The configuration relationship where a distance metric parameterizes the similarity measure of a Pinecone index.

nodes.label: consistency model
nodes.def: The concurrency and staleness guarantees provided by a distributed vector database: strong consistency requires all replicas to agree before returning, while eventual consistency a

nodes.label: constrains pinecone query
nodes.def: The gating relationship where a filter expression restricts query results to records matching indexed scalar field conditions.

nodes.label: contains pinecone dense vector
nodes.def: The composition relationship where a Pinecone record embeds dense vector values representing semantic embeddings for ANN search.

nodes.label: contains pinecone index
nodes.def: The organizational relationship where a Pinecone project holds one or more indexes as its primary data collections.

nodes.label: contains pinecone sparse vector
nodes.def: The composition relationship where a Pinecone record optionally embeds sparse vector dimensions for hybrid dense-sparse retrieval.

nodes.label: contrastive learning
nodes.def: A self-supervised training objective that pulls semantically similar pairs of embeddings together while pushing dissimilar pairs apart in the vector space.

nodes.label: creates pinecone index
nodes.def: The provisioning relationship where an index creation operation establishes a new named vector collection with specified configuration.

nodes.label: deduplication
nodes.def: The process of detecting and eliminating near-duplicate or exact-duplicate embedding vectors from a vector database to reduce storage waste and retrieval noise.

nodes.label: delete operation
nodes.def: The removal of a specific vector and its associated metadata from a vector database, with behavior varying from immediate physical removal to soft-delete with periodic compaction.

nodes.label: deletion marking
nodes.def: Soft-delete approach: mark vector as inactive in metadata; physical removal deferred to periodic index compaction.

nodes.label: dense passage retrieval
nodes.def: The use of dense bi-encoder embeddings to retrieve relevant text passages from a corpus, typically trained with contrastive loss on question-answer pairs.

nodes.label: dequantization
nodes.def: The reverse operation converting int8 back to float32 for computation; performed as (int8_value * scale_factor) + zero_point for asymmetric, or int8_value * scale_factor for symmet

nodes.label: dimensionality reduction
nodes.def: A family of techniques (PCA, UMAP, autoencoders) that project high-dimensional embedding vectors into a lower-dimensional space while preserving pairwise distance structure for vis

nodes.label: dot product similarity
nodes.def: Raw inner product of unnormalized vectors; correlates with cosine similarity but is magnitude-sensitive.

nodes.label: embedding as service
nodes.def: Microservice exposing trained embedding model via HTTP/gRPC; handles batching, caching, and model versioning independently of the DB.

nodes.label: embedding finetuning
nodes.def: Adapting a pretrained embedding model to a specific domain or task via contrastive or triplet loss on labeled data.

nodes.label: euclidean distance
nodes.def: The L2 geometric distance between two embedding vectors computed as the square root of the sum of squared dimension differences; smaller values indicate greater similarity.

nodes.label: hosts pinecone serverless index
nodes.def: The hosting relationship where a cloud provider infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) runs a Pinecone serverless index deployment.

nodes.label: idx faiss index factory
nodes.def: FAISS API selecting index type and factory string for automatic parameter defaults and memory estimates

nodes.label: idx gpu acceleration
nodes.def: Use of GPU kernels for index construction or querying requiring specific index types and memory layout

nodes.label: idx hnsw params
nodes.def: Hyperparameters governing HNSW construction and search efConstruction m and ef controlling graph density and traversal depth

nodes.label: idx ivf params
nodes.def: Inverted file index hyperparameters nlist clusters and nprobe probe counts controlling partition granularity and search scope

nodes.label: immutability
nodes.def: A database design choice where vectors are never updated in place; changes are appended as new versioned records, eliminating concurrent-read/write conflicts in distributed index s

nodes.label: implements ann index
nodes.def: The implementation relationship where a Pinecone index provides approximate nearest neighbor search over stored vector collections.

nodes.label: integrates with embedding model
nodes.def: The integration relationship where a vector database connects to embedding models to ingest, store, and search generated vector representations.

nodes.label: introspects pinecone index
nodes.def: The inspection relationship where an operation retrieves index metadata including dimension, namespace record counts, and storage fullness metrics.

nodes.label: k means
nodes.def: A centroid-based clustering algorithm that iteratively assigns vectors to nearest centroids and updates centroids as the cluster mean; used to build IVF and PQ codebooks.

nodes.label: manages vector database
nodes.def: The management relationship where a service (such as Pinecone) orchestrates vector storage, indexing, and querying infrastructure.

nodes.label: maximum marginal relevance
nodes.def: Diversification technique penalizing results too similar to already-selected items; balances relevance against coverage in top-k lists.

nodes.label: modifies pinecone index
nodes.def: The reconfiguration relationship where an operation adjusts index properties such as replica count, pod type, or serverless settings.

nodes.label: multilingual embedding
nodes.def: Embedding model trained on cross-lingual data enabling semantic similarity across languages in a shared vector space.

nodes.label: online learning
nodes.def: A training strategy that continuously updates embedding model weights from incoming queries and feedback in real time without full retraining from the complete historical corpus.

nodes.label: partitions pinecone index
nodes.def: The isolation relationship where a namespace divides a shared index into tenant-scoped record collections without separate infrastructure.

nodes.label: pca
nodes.def: Principal Component Analysis: a linear dimensionality reduction method that projects vectors onto the top k orthogonal axes of maximum variance in the embedding space.

nodes.label: pinecone api key
nodes.def: A scoped credential for authenticating REST or gRPC calls to a Pinecone project.

nodes.label: pinecone cloud provider
nodes.def: The infrastructure provider hosting a Pinecone serverless index: aws, gcp, or azure.

nodes.label: pinecone collection
nodes.def: A read-only snapshot of a Pinecone index stored as a named artifact, used for backup or index cloning.

nodes.label: pinecone configure index
nodes.def: An index reconfiguration operation in Pinecone that adjusts replicas, pod type, or serverless settings.

nodes.label: pinecone create index
nodes.def: An index provisioning operation in Pinecone that specifies name, dimension, metric, and pod or serverless configuration.

nodes.label: pinecone delete
nodes.def: A write operation that removes records from a Pinecone index by id, filter, or namespace.

nodes.label: pinecone dense vector
nodes.def: A Pinecone record component representing dense embedding values for ANN search.

nodes.label: pinecone describe index stats
nodes.def: An introspection operation that returns index metadata including dimension, count per namespace, and index fullness.

nodes.label: pinecone distance metric
nodes.def: A configurable similarity measure in Pinecone: cosine, euclidean, or dotproduct.

nodes.label: pinecone fetch
nodes.def: A read operation that retrieves records by explicit id list from a Pinecone index.

nodes.label: pinecone filter expression
nodes.def: A metadata filtering construct in Pinecone query that gates results via indexed scalar fields.

nodes.label: pinecone index
nodes.def: A named searchable collection of vectors in Pinecone, configurable with dimension, metric, and pod/serverless settings.

nodes.label: pinecone multi tenancy
nodes.def: A Pinecone isolation model using namespaces within a shared index to serve multiple tenants.

nodes.label: pinecone namespace
nodes.def: A tenant isolation boundary within a Pinecone index that partitions records without separate infrastructure.

nodes.label: pinecone pod index
nodes.def: A pod-based index deployment model in Pinecone using pre-allocated compute resources with configurable replicas.

nodes.label: pinecone serverless index
nodes.def: A serverless index deployment model in Pinecone that auto-scales compute and storage without pod management.

nodes.label: pinecone sparse vector
nodes.def: A Pinecone record component representing sparse dimensions (token id + values) for hybrid retrieval.

nodes.label: pinecone upsert
nodes.def: A write operation that inserts or updates records in a Pinecone index by unique id.

nodes.label: rag retrieval
nodes.def: Retrieval-Augmented Generation pattern: vector search fetches relevant context chunks, injected into LLM prompt to ground generation.

nodes.label: receives query vector
nodes.def: The input relationship where a query operation accepts an embedding vector as the basis for nearest-neighbor similarity search.

nodes.label: replication
nodes.def: The duplication of vector index shards across multiple nodes to improve read throughput, fault tolerance, and geographic query latency without changing the logical data set.

nodes.label: returns pinecone similarity score
nodes.def: The output relationship where a query operation yields relevance scores indicating how closely each result matches the query vector.

nodes.label: scopes pinecone api key
nodes.def: The authorization relationship where a Pinecone project defines the boundary of access granted by an associated API key.

nodes.label: snapshots pinecone index
nodes.def: The preservation relationship where a collection captures a point-in-time read-only copy of an index for backup or cloning purposes.

nodes.label: sq saturation
nodes.def: Behavior when an input value exceeds the representable range; values are clipped to min/max of target dtype.

nodes.label: symmetric quantization
nodes.def: A quantization scheme where the float range is centered at zero and only a scale factor is used; the zero point is implicitly zero; maps [-max_abs, max_abs] to [-127, 127].

nodes.label: transports pinecone query
nodes.def: The transport relationship where the gRPC API layer carries query requests and responses between client and Pinecone index service.

nodes.label: transports pinecone upsert
nodes.def: The transport relationship where the gRPC API layer carries upsert requests and acknowledgments between client and Pinecone index service.

nodes.label: update operation
nodes.def: The replacement of an existing vector's embedding values or payload metadata, requiring the database to update the relevant index structures without full index reconstruction.

nodes.label: uses approximate nearest neighbor search
nodes.def: The algorithm relationship where a Pinecone query executes ANN search to efficiently return near neighbors rather than exact matches.

nodes.label: uses pinecone namespace
nodes.def: The tenancy relationship where a multi-tenant configuration employs namespaces to isolate tenant data within a shared index.

nodes.label: vector normalization
nodes.def: Scaling embedding to unit L2 norm; makes cosine similarity equivalent to dot product and prevents magnitude from distorting similarity.

nodes.label: weaviate
nodes.def: An open-source vector database with built-in module support for embedding models (transformers, CLIP), hybrid BM25-plus-vector search, and GraphQL API.

nodes.label: word embedding
nodes.def: Vector representation of individual words; methods include word2vec (Skip-gram, CBOW) and GloVe; captures word co-occurrence statistics.

nodes.label: wraps pinecone grpc api
nodes.def: The abstraction relationship where the official Python client provides typed gRPC method wrappers for low-latency vector operations.

nodes.label: wraps pinecone rest api
nodes.def: The abstraction relationship where the official Python client provides typed REST method wrappers for HTTP-based vector operations.

nodes.label: distributed vector search
nodes.def: A sharded or replicated deployment of a vector database across multiple nodes to achieve horizontal scalability, with query routing and result merge across partition boundaries.

nodes.label: domain adaptation
nodes.def: The process of adjusting a generic embedding model so that its learned representations better capture the semantic structure of a specific domain or vocabulary.

nodes.label: dot product
nodes.def: An inner-product similarity computed as the sum of element-wise products between two vectors; when vectors are L2-normalized it is equivalent to cosine similarity.

nodes.label: edge embedding
nodes.def: A vector representation of a graph edge or relationship, often computed as a function (e.g., Hadamard product, concatenation) of the two endpoint node embeddings.

nodes.label: elasticsearch vector
nodes.def: The dense vector field type and kNN search capability added to Elasticsearch 8.0+; supports cosine and dot-product similarity with approximate HNSW indexing.

nodes.label: elbow method
nodes.def: A heuristic for selecting the optimal number of clusters in k-means by identifying the bend point in a plot of within-cluster sum of squares (WCSS) versus k.

nodes.label: embedding
nodes.def: A dense vector representation of data (text, image, audio) produced by a neural model that encodes semantic meaning into a numerical array.

nodes.label: embedding model selection
nodes.def: The process of choosing an optimal embedding model (BERT, OpenAI ada, SBERT, CLIP) based on dimension budget, latency constraints, retrieval quality benchmarks, and licensing const

nodes.label: embedding normalization
nodes.def: The process of scaling embedding vectors to unit Euclidean length; enables cosine similarity to be computed as a simple dot product between normalized vectors.

nodes.label: embedding quality
nodes.def: An evaluation of how well an embedding space captures target semantic relationships, measured by downstream task accuracy, clustering quality metrics, or similarity probe benchmark

nodes.label: embedding serving
nodes.def: The infrastructure layer that exposes an embedding model as a low-latency HTTP or gRPC API, typically with batching, GPU inference, and horizontal scaling.

nodes.label: entity embedding
nodes.def: A dense vector representation of a real-world entity (person, place, organization) learned jointly with other entities in a knowledge graph or recommendation embedding table.

nodes.label: exact search
nodes.def: A brute-force scan of all vectors in a database to return provably correct nearest neighbors; prohibitively expensive at scale but used as the ground truth for evaluating ANN quali

nodes.label: false positive rate
nodes.def: The fraction of retrieved nearest neighbors that are not true nearest neighbors; a key metric for evaluating the quality of approximate nearest neighbor search results.

nodes.label: fine tuning
nodes.def: The continued training of a pre-trained embedding model on a domain-specific dataset to improve its ability to distinguish relevant semantic relationships in a targeted use case.

nodes.label: float32 base
nodes.def: The 32-bit IEEE floating-point representation of a vector element prior to quantization; each value occupies 4 bytes and spans the full numerical range of float32.

nodes.label: fp16 quantization
nodes.def: A reduced-precision format that stores embedding dimensions as 16-bit IEEE half-precision floats, halving storage while maintaining near-fp32 retrieval quality for most embedding m

nodes.label: freshness
nodes.def: A system property measuring how recently the vector database reflects the current state of the indexed corpus; affected by indexing latency, batch size, and incremental update freq

nodes.label: gpu acceleration
nodes.def: The use of graphics processing units to parallelize ANN computations (HNSW search, IVF scanning, PQ distance) achieving orders-of-magnitude throughput improvements over CPU-only im

nodes.label: graph index
nodes.def: An index structure that models the embedding space as a navigable proximity graph where edges connect nearest neighbor vectors at each layer.

nodes.label: graph neural network
nodes.def: A neural architecture that operates on graph-structured data by propagating and transforming embedding vectors along edges and through node aggregation layers.

nodes.label: hard negative
nodes.def: A negative training example that is semantically similar to the anchor (e.g., same topic or category) and thus creates stronger discrimination pressure during contrastive training.

nodes.label: high dimensional space
nodes.def: The mathematical n-dimensional Euclidean (or inner-product) space in which embedding vectors reside; dimensionality typically ranges from 64 to 4096.

nodes.label: hnsw
nodes.def: Hierarchical Navigable Small World: a graph-based ANN index that builds a multi-layer skip-list of proximity graphs, enabling logarithmic-time greedy search from an entry point.

nodes.label: idx accuracy threshold
nodes.def: Minimum acceptable accuracy or recall rate below which results are unacceptable for the application

nodes.label: idx build time budget
nodes.def: Maximum acceptable index construction time constraining algorithm complexity and sampling choices

nodes.label: idx throughput target
nodes.def: Target queries per second rate constraining parallelization and batch processing strategy

nodes.label: index build time
nodes.def: The wall-clock time required to construct a vector index from a corpus; varies from seconds (IVFFlat) to minutes (HNSW with high M/efConstruction) for billion-scale datasets.

nodes.label: index size
nodes.def: The disk or memory footprint of a built ANN index, typically expressed in bytes per stored vector and overhead factors from the index structure.

nodes.label: inner product
nodes.def: The raw dot product between two unnormalized vectors; used as a similarity score for models that produce vectors in a non-normalized space.

nodes.label: int8 quantization
nodes.def: Post-training quantization that converts 32-bit floating-point embedding dimensions to 8-bit signed or unsigned integers, reducing memory footprint and enabling faster integer arit

nodes.label: int8 representation
nodes.def: The 8-bit signed integer result of scalar quantization, mapping the original float32 range onto [-128, 127] or the unsigned variant [0, 255]; occupies 1 byte per element.

nodes.label: inverted file index
nodes.def: An index that partitions the vector space into Voronoi cells (clusters) and maintains an inverted list of vectors per cell centroid, enabling scope-limited search.

nodes.label: knowledge graph embedding
nodes.def: A set of learned dense vectors representing entities and relation types in a knowledge graph, enabling link prediction and reasoning via vector arithmetic.

nodes.label: local sensitive hashing
nodes.def: A hashing scheme that maps similar vectors to the same hash bucket with high probability; variants include signed random projection (SRP) for cosine similarity and Hamming LSH for

nodes.label: manhattan distance
nodes.def: The L1 distance between two vectors computed as the sum of absolute dimension differences; useful for high-dimensional sparse embedding spaces.

nodes.label: memory mapped files
nodes.def: An I/O strategy where the vector index files are mapped into the process address space, allowing the operating system's virtual memory manager to handle paging of large indexes fro

nodes.label: memory savings ratio
nodes.def: The factor by which memory_footprint is reduced, expressed as original_bytes / quantized_bytes; scalar quantization achieves approximately 4x savings (32-bit to 8-bit).

nodes.label: multimodal embedding
nodes.def: A shared embedding space where text and images (or other modalities) are projected into the same vector space enabling cross-modal retrieval.

nodes.label: negative sampling
nodes.def: A training strategy in contrastive embedding models that randomly selects unrelated examples as negatives; hard negatives are semi-hard examples within a proximity margin that prov

nodes.label: neural network embedding
nodes.def: The output tensor produced by the final hidden layer of a neural embedding model; the vector stored and indexed in the vector database.

nodes.label: node embedding
nodes.def: A dense vector representation of a graph node learned by graph embedding methods such as DeepWalk, Node2Vec, or GraphSAGE for downstream node classification or link prediction.

nodes.label: overlap strategy
nodes.def: A chunking configuration that preserves a configurable number of tokens from the end of one chunk at the start of the next chunk to reduce information loss at segment boundaries.

nodes.label: per channel quantization
nodes.def: A granularity variant where each channel (dimension) has its own scale_factor, reducing precision loss for tensors with heterogeneous value distributions across dimensions.

nodes.label: per tensor quantization
nodes.def: A granularity variant where a single scale_factor and optionally zero_point applies to all elements in an entire tensor or vector.

nodes.label: pgvector
nodes.def: A PostgreSQL extension that adds vector data type, L2/inner-product/cosine distance operators, and IVFFlat/HNSW index support within the Postgres query planner.

nodes.label: pinecone dimension
nodes.def: The fixed vector dimensionality of a Pinecone index, set at creation and immutable thereafter.

nodes.label: pinecone index status
nodes.def: A runtime state of a Pinecone index: Initializing, Ready, Initializing, Upgrading, Scaling, or Error.

nodes.label: pinecone query vector
nodes.def: The target vector submitted to Pinecone query for ANN retrieval.

nodes.label: pinecone range search
nodes.def: A query variant in Pinecone returning all vectors within a given radius of a query vector.

nodes.label: pinecone region
nodes.def: The geographic availability zone for a Pinecone index or project.

nodes.label: pinecone similarity score
nodes.def: The numeric proximity value returned with each Pinecone query result, interpreting the configured distance metric.

nodes.label: pinecone sla
nodes.def: A service-level guarantee attached to a Pinecone project specifying availability and support terms.

nodes.label: pinecone top k
nodes.def: The count of nearest neighbors returned per Pinecone query request.

nodes.label: precision
nodes.def: The fraction of returned results that are genuine nearest neighbors; precision at k measures how clean the top-k list is in an ANN retrieval.

nodes.label: precision at k
nodes.def: The fraction of the top-k retrieved results that are true nearest neighbors; a standard retrieval quality metric reported at k values like 1, 10, or 100.

nodes.label: precision loss
nodes.def: The accuracy degradation resulting from mapping continuous float32 values to a discrete int8 representation; measured as mean squared error, cosine similarity drop, or recall degra

nodes.label: quantization error
nodes.def: The difference between the original float32 value and the reconstructed value after dequantization; the primary source of precision_loss in scalar_quantization.

nodes.label: rag pipeline
nodes.def: The full software pipeline that connects a vector database, an embedding model, a retrieval step, and a language model into an end-to-end RAG system with query parsing and response

nodes.label: recall
nodes.def: The fraction of true nearest neighbors that appear within the result set returned by an approximate nearest neighbor search; a primary quality metric for ANN indexes.

nodes.label: retrieval augmented generation
nodes.def: A generation architecture that retrieves relevant context vectors from a vector database at inference time and prepends the decoded context to the language model prompt to reduce h

nodes.label: scale factor
nodes.def: The multiplicative factor used to convert float32 values to int8 and back; computed as (value_range_max - value_range_min) / (quantization_range_max - quantization_range_min).

nodes.label: semantic cache
nodes.def: A caching strategy that stores query vectors alongside their results and answers new queries by finding the nearest cached vector rather than recomputing the full retrieval pipelin

nodes.label: sharding
nodes.def: The horizontal partitioning of a vector collection across multiple database nodes based on a partitioning scheme (range, hash, or vector-space Voronoi cells) to distribute query lo

nodes.label: similarity search
nodes.def: The operation of finding vectors in a database that are most semantically or geometrically similar to a given query vector.

nodes.label: sliding window
nodes.def: A text segmentation strategy that moves a fixed-length token window over a document with a configurable step size to produce overlapping chunks for embedding.

nodes.label: soft delete
nodes.def: A deletion strategy that marks a vector as inactive in the payload without immediately removing it from the ANN index; physical removal occurs during periodic garbage collection.

nodes.label: sq calibration
nodes.def: Process of determining optimal scale and offset values from a data distribution (often percentile-based).

nodes.label: sq calibration data
nodes.def: Representative sample of vectors used to determine scale_factor and zero_point; must cover the distribution to minimize quantization_error.

nodes.label: sq decode
nodes.def: Inverse transformation that reconstructs float approximations from quantized integers using scale and offset.

nodes.label: sq dtype
nodes.def: Target integer type for quantized values (e.g. int8, uint8); defines bit-width of stored representation.

nodes.label: sq encoding
nodes.def: Bit-packing scheme for storing quantized values contiguously; enables dense memory layout.

nodes.label: sq error
nodes.def: Quantization error (e.g. MSE) introduced by value rounding; trade-off against compression ratio.

nodes.label: sq offset
nodes.def: Zero-point value added during quantization (often for signed int8 centering around 0); subtracted at decode.

nodes.label: sq outlier handling
nodes.def: Strategy for values exceeding the calibrated value_range; options include clipping, separate outlier scale, or exclusion from quantization.

nodes.label: sq per channel mode
nodes.def: Scalar quantization variant where scale_factor is computed per column/feature dimension; reduces quantization_error at cost of storing multiple scales.

nodes.label: sq per tensor mode
nodes.def: Scalar quantization variant where one scale_factor applies to the entire tensor; simpler but less accurate for heterogeneous distributions.

nodes.label: sq precision level
nodes.def: Target bit-width for quantized representation (e.g., int8, int16, float16); determines memory_footprint reduction ratio.

nodes.label: sq quantization error
nodes.def: Difference between original floating-point values and reconstructed values after dequantization; primary quality metric for scalar_quantization.

nodes.label: sq scale
nodes.def: Floating-point multiplier that maps original values to the quantized integer range; inverse applied at decode time.

nodes.label: sq scale factor
nodes.def: Multiplier applied during dequantization; computed from calibration_data to map quantized integer back to floating-point.

nodes.label: sq scheme
nodes.def: Per-tensor vs per-dimension quantization scope; global uses one scale/offset for entire tensor.

nodes.label: sq signal to noise ratio
nodes.def: Ratio of signal power to quantization_error power; used to assess quality loss from scalar_quantization relative to full-precision.

nodes.label: sq value range
nodes.def: Observed min-max bounds of floating-point values across the tensor being quantized; determines scale_factor magnitude.

nodes.label: sq zero point
nodes.def: Integer offset used in asymmetric quantization; enables efficient storage of value ranges not centered at zero.

nodes.label: streaming embedding
nodes.def: The online computation of embedding vectors from a continuous data stream as new items arrive, without requiring reprocessing of the entire existing corpus.

nodes.label: text embedding
nodes.def: A dense vector generated from a textual input (word, phrase, sentence, document) by a transformer or sentence-transformer model.

nodes.label: transfer learning
nodes.def: The practice of initializing an embedding model from weights pre-trained on a large corpus and then adapting those weights to a target downstream task.

nodes.label: triplet loss
nodes.def: A training loss that penalizes embeddings where the distance between an anchor and a negative example is not sufficiently larger than the distance between the anchor and a positive

nodes.label: tsne
nodes.def: t-Distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding: a non-linear dimensionality reduction method that emphasizes preservation of local neighborhood structure for visualization of high-dim

nodes.label: umap
nodes.def: Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection: a non-linear dimensionality reduction technique that preserves both local and some global topological structure and is faster than t-

nodes.label: value range calibration
nodes.def: The process of determining the min and max values (or percentile-based thresholds) across a representative dataset to compute optimal scale_factor and zero_point.

nodes.label: vector index
nodes.def: A data structure inside a vector database that enables fast approximate nearest neighbor retrieval over collections of embedding vectors.

nodes.label: vector quantization
nodes.def: The process of mapping a high-precision embedding vector to a lower-precision representative codeword to reduce storage size and speed up distance computations.

nodes.label: vector serving
nodes.def: The infrastructure layer that exposes a vector database as a query API, handling index routing, sharding, replication, and result aggregation across nodes.

nodes.label: versioning
nodes.def: The tracking of multiple embedding versions for the same logical record, enabling time-travel queries, rollback of noisy embeddings, and lineage tracking for debugging.

nodes.label: visualization
nodes.def: The projection of embedding vectors into 2D or 3D space for human inspection of clustering, separation, and outlier structure in the learned semantic space.

nodes.label: weighted average
nodes.def: A simple embedding aggregation method that computes a convex combination of multiple vectors, optionally weighting chunks by their relevance score or local importance.

nodes.label: zero point
nodes.def: An additive offset applied in asymmetric quantization to shift the zero point of the float range onto an integer value, enabling exact representation of true zero.
